summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Commercial Banking Relationship Screen Flow. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passing (metadata, search filters incl. name/level/country/industry/status/relationshipId, get-by-id 200/404, POST L1/L2 success + persistence, POST L3/L4 400). Frontend: Steps 1-4 all functional. Level cards render, L3/L4 correctly disabled, Next gated until creatable level chosen. Step 2 all 5 search inputs + demo preset render. Name search 'Apex' returned 5 matching rows. 'Load all sample records' loaded seeded records into the datatable. DataTable global search filtered rows (horizon -> 5), pagination controls & page-size select present, col-header sort clickable. Preview drawer opens/closes with per-record buttons; select-button launches read-only LaunchView. Create flow (L1) validation triggers on empty submit; invalid RID pattern is enforced; valid submit creates record, shows create-success-banner, LaunchView renders new record, record persisted in Mongo (verified via API list). L2 create form contains 'Parent (L1) Relationship' populated with all L1 names including newly created ones.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' at DataTable.jsx:97. Caused by rendering non-text nodes inside <option>. Not user-visible but pollutes console; consider rendering plain text inside <option> (e.g. `{n}`) or moving formatting outside.

action_items: (Optional) Fix DataTable.jsx:97 hydration warning by ensuring <option> children are plain text.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event; fine for prototype but consider lifespan handlers.

CORS allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' is invalid per CORS spec (browsers ignore credentials with wildcard). Use explicit origin list if credentials really needed, else drop allow_credentials.

Seeded records use non-uniform relationshipId prefixes (REL-/LE-/FA-). Backend regex filter uses case-insensitive substring match which is fine but the create form enforces REL-###### only for L1/L2 (consistent with spec).
DataTable page-size <option> children include injected span (likely visual editor overlay); ensure production build strips such attributes.
seed_data_creation: 3 TEST_ prefixed records created via POST during tests (2 by pytest, 1 by Playwright). Safe to leave; visible in datatable/parent picklist.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4-step flow works end-to-end. Testids to know: level-card-L{1..4}, level-next-button, search-name-input, search-relationshipid-input, search-country/industry/status-select, demo-preset-button, search-submit-button, reset-filters-button (NOT search-reset-button), results-back-button, results-create-button, empty-create-button, path-step-<n>, table-global-search, colfilter-<col>, col-header-<col>, table-next-page, table-prev-page, table-page-size, preview-button-<id>, select-button-<id>, preview-drawer, preview-close, preview-launch-button, launch-view, step-create-form, create-<field>-select, submit-create-account-button, create-success-banner, create-parentRelationship-select (L2 only).
